caption: The Chief Ladiga Trail runs nearly forty miles from Anniston to the Georgia line. Conroy helped make it Alabama's first rail-trail.

alt: Chief Ladiga Trail near the old depot
caption: In April 2025 the trail was extended to the Anniston Amtrak depot.
The corridor runs through Weaver, Jacksonville, and Piedmont.
Forty miles of mostly gentle grade, open year round.
